feature: Namespaced URL state and browser history synchronization for authored tab groups.

implementation.url_contract: Each selected same-page tab is represented as creator-tab=<validated node id>:<zero-based item index>; unrelated query parameters and up to 40 other valid tab states are retained.
implementation.restore: Initial load and popstate restore all authored tab groups; groups absent from URL return to their first tab; malformed, out-of-range, unknown and oversized entries are ignored.
implementation.editor_isolation: The Editor Canvas continues to activate tabs but does not rewrite the Editor top-level URL; the real Preview/public renderer may use tab URL state.
implementation.safety: Only validated Page Model node IDs and bounded indexes are applied; no selector interpolation, script, navigation, external URL or data mutation is introduced.
implementation.save_publish: Tab selection is view state only. The existing Page Model Save and separate Publish transaction remain independent.
